description: Put the link of a handoff seal you made on the user's clipboard again, or in its private file, by its handle: for a link lost before it reached the recipient. You never get the link itself. An inbox seal is already in its inbox, and a forward link came back to you.

handle.description: Handle of a handoff seal from seal_share or seal_list.

name: seal_link
title: Hand over a seal link again
